name: Screen Studio Kit
tagline: Design every store screenshot from one reusable composition.
desc_full: A native desktop editor for composing, localizing, validating, capturing, and publishing store-ready screenshots across phones, tablets, desktops, televisions, watches, and spatial devices.
builder_bio: Independent software developer behind DevDock, Diff Anything, and Screen Studio Kit. I build practical desktop tools around real workflows.
builder_story: I built Screen Studio Kit because store artwork is real product work, but rebuilding the same composition for every size and language never felt like it should be.

name: Diff Anything
tagline: Compare the files developers actually work with—not just text.
desc_full: A private, local-first desktop comparison and merge application for text, structured data, folders, archives, documents, API schemas, HTTP responses, images, binaries, and command-line workflows.
builder_bio: Independent software developer behind DevDock, Diff Anything, and Screen Studio Kit. I build practical desktop tools around real workflows.
builder_story: I built Diff Anything because the useful question is rarely ‘which lines changed?’ It is ‘what changed in the thing I am actually looking at?’
